items.description: The surface carries a repair signed by someone who refused to discard a useful thing. A familiar pattern, altered by many hands until no two remember it the same way. A keepsake; no gameplay effect is configured.

items.name: Hollow-Signal Circuit Loop
items.description: A small inscription beneath the grip reads: a borrowed purpose is still a choice. A disputed maker's mark survives inside. Neither claimant wished the other erased. A keepsake; no gameplay effect is configured.
